service_boundary: Represents the international platform operated by a Hong Kong entity, not the separately operated mainland platform whose catalogue and documentation are broader.
regional_controls: No customer-selectable region. The privacy policy states servers are located in the United States, with onward transfers to affiliates and processors. A data-processing agreement with standard contractual clauses is offered.
retention_controls: No retention period for prompts or outputs is documented. The terms take a perpetual, irrevocable, sublicensable licence over outputs, prompts, and associated call logs for any purpose including commercialisation, and separately state that this usage data, including personal data within prompts and outputs, may be used to train and improve the operator's models. The only stated remedy is not to participate in the relevant programme.
routing: Callers name a model. No routing, fallback, or steering controls are documented.
customization: No fine-tuning, adapter training, or distillation is documented.
strengths: Numeric concurrency, request, and token limits are published across spend tiers.
A data-processing agreement with standard contractual clauses is offered, which the mainland platform does not publish.
Two compatible conventions and a newer response interface sit on one host alongside a native realtime socket.
tradeoffs: The terms take a perpetual and irrevocable licence over prompts, outputs, and call logs for any purpose, and permit training on them with no opt-out short of leaving the programme.
No service-level agreement, no status page, and no changelog.
The documentation set is materially smaller than the mainland platform's and omits several published capabilities.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: StepFun platform quickstart, for StepFun Open Platform (international)

upstream_disclosure.note: The platform privacy policy states the operator receives API content: "When a commercial customer participates in our StepFun Startup Program or other early access program-based project and accesses our internal models through an API Key, it may share API-related data with us, including Prompts, Outputs, API call logs, and other information submitted through or generated by the API." No subprocessor is named.
upstream_disclosure.scope: StepFun platform privacy policy, for StepFun Open Platform (international)

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: "Go to the Account Management submenu on the console and open Interface Keys to create a key."
credential_handling.scope: StepFun platform quickstart, for StepFun Open Platform (international)

cache_isolation.note: The prompt-cache guide documents the feature and its billing but never states whether a cache is scoped to the account that created it.
cache_isolation.scope: StepFun prompt-cache guide, for StepFun Open Platform (international)

vulnerability_disclosure.note: The terms offer only a general contact ("Users with questions, complaints or claims with respect to the Services can be made by contacting us at platform@stepfun.com."); no security contact or disclosure policy is published and no security.txt is served.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: StepFun platform terms of service, for StepFun Open Platform (international)

independent_audit.note: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent attestation is named in the platform documentation, the terms, or the privacy policy.
independent_audit.scope: StepFun platform quickstart, for StepFun Open Platform (international)
